changelog: Three new failure patterns from real gateway incidents: (1) clean-exit supervisor restart treated as final by Restart=on-failure service units — use Restart=always plus StartLimitBurst; (2) impostor gateway — a stale superseded unit serving the port with passing health checks while dispatching nothing; (3) native module bindings missing after plugin install/update, including the ignore-scripts=true trap that makes npm rebuild a silent no-op. Also documents the 2026.6.x npm/projects managed plugin layout. SKILL.md pitfalls and update-failure-patterns.md (patterns 24-26) updated.
